comparison.objective: Scan every grocery item before bagging it; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests item handling, scanner presentation, ordering, and bag placement; candidate tests bimanual adjustment, tool use, controlled locking torque, and dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires every item scanned before entering the bag; candidate requires two safe repeatable stops plus retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: The procedural scanning constraint does not test mechanical adjustment or impact absorption. The record has no specs and omits scan-validation and bagging-damage details.
